trigger.reason: A new applied workshop needs a shared capability target before the facilitator guide and participant materials are produced.
inspectedEvidence: Sponsor brief on maintenance handoff failures
Participant role map for planning and field teams

programme.subject: Planning maintenance work across office and field teams
programme.scope: A half-day workshop on writing executable work orders and resolving exceptions before equipment downtime expands
programme.audience: Maintenance planners, field supervisors, stores coordinators, and operations managers
programme.startingPoint: Learners know their own stage of the process but rarely see how assumptions change across the complete work order

thesis.recognisedProblem: A work order can be complete in the planning system and still be unusable when the field team reaches the equipment.
thesis.promisedLearnerChange: Learners leave able to write and stress-test one maintenance handoff whose information, materials, authority, and exception route remain usable in the field.
thesis.centralQuestion: What must travel with a work order for another team to execute it safely under real conditions?
thesis.distinctiveArgument: The quality of a maintenance plan is revealed at the handoff where another team must act without reconstructing the planner's assumptions.
thesis.argumentBoundary: The workshop improves planning and coordination practice but does not certify technical procedures or replace site safety controls.
thesis.changedCondition: Planning and field work now occur across separate shifts and locations, reducing the informal clarification that once repaired incomplete work orders.

transformationLens.reason: The enduring requirement is executable maintenance work, while distributed shifts change how context and exceptions must travel.
transformationLens.governingQuestion: What must remain available when informal clarification is replaced by a cross-location handoff?

evidenceBoundaries.claim: The sampled work orders were administratively complete while field teams still needed missing context before execution.
evidenceBoundaries.attribution: Programme designer's review of sponsor-supplied records
evidenceBoundaries.observedScope: Three anonymised work orders selected by the sponsor for programme discovery
evidenceBoundaries.known: Each record contained a later clarification request from the field team.
evidenceBoundaries.uncertain: The small purposive sample does not estimate the frequency of the problem across all sites.
evidenceBoundaries.allowedUse: Use to construct a bounded workshop problem and realistic practice case.

evidenceBoundaries.claim: The sponsor's planning and field teams now work across separate shifts and locations.
evidenceBoundaries.attribution: Sponsor role map and process walkthrough
evidenceBoundaries.observedScope: The participating maintenance unit and the workflow selected for this workshop
evidenceBoundaries.known: The named roles do not share every shift or physical location.
evidenceBoundaries.uncertain: Other units may retain more direct access to planners during execution.
evidenceBoundaries.allowedUse: Use to set the workshop's handoff condition without generalising across the organisation.

evidenceBoundaries.claim: Testing whether another team can execute the work order exposes assumptions hidden by administrative completeness.
evidenceBoundaries.known: The sampled clarification requests appeared at the transfer from planning to field execution.
evidenceBoundaries.uncertain: Different equipment and sites may expose different missing assumptions.
evidenceBoundaries.allowedUse: Use as the workshop proposition and test it through participant-owned work orders.

carriedProof.name: Executable Maintenance Handoff
carriedProof.initialState: A work order judged complete by the team that created it
carriedProof.finalState: A field-tested handoff with context, materials, authority, stop conditions, and escalation routes
carriedProof.successEvidence: A different team can explain and begin the work without inventing missing assumptions.

capabilityProgression.learnerMove: Learners identify the assumptions that disappear between planning and field execution.
capabilityProgression.proofAdded: The handoff record distinguishes stated information from context held only by the planner.
capabilityProgression.handoff: The missing context creates a test of field usability.

capabilityProgression.learnerMove: Learners test the work order against changed field conditions and material constraints.
capabilityProgression.proofAdded: The record shows which change pauses work and who can resolve the exception.
capabilityProgression.handoff: The tested exception route can now be written into the final handoff.

capabilityProgression.learnerMove: Learners revise their work order so that another team can execute and challenge it safely.
capabilityProgression.proofAdded: The completed handoff records information, materials, authority, stop conditions, and escalation.
capabilityProgression.handoff: The revised record is ready for a live field review after the workshop.

approval.provenance: The sponsor approved the applied workshop thesis and carried performance in the design review.

productionDecision.nextAction: Write the workshop case and facilitation guide around the Executable Maintenance Handoff.
